hazards.control: Pressure test before opening to the well; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.

name: Sliding sleeve (production)
function: A tubing sub with ports covered by an inner sleeve that slickline shifts open to circulate between the tubing and the annulus, used to kill, unload, or displace the well.

tabs.overview: Shifted with a slickline tool; closed in normal production. Different from the frac sleeve in the casing.
tabs.engineering: Rated with the tubing; seals inspected at workovers.
tabs.safety: Left closed and confirmed before pressure work.
tabs.evidence: API 6A scope for trees (S1), API Spec 14A for safety valves (S29), API 11D1 for packers (S21), field practice (S9). Photographs read for proportion only.
